summary: Replace a targeted object in a source video with a reference object across all frames, preserving occlusion, lighting and camera motion.

inputs.name: targetRegion
inputs.constraints: mask or bounding hint of the object to replace

parameters.name: blendStrength
parameters.description: How strongly the replacement replaces the original object.

qualityDimensions.description: Stability of the replacement across frames.
